note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the two scenes are shown side by side without a winner or conclusion.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional interview: in A the client gives the detail as 'the same week' (the pen loops days 1–7); in B the detail is clarified as 'day 3' (the pen rings day 3).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the client speaks first (sequence client→interviewer), a five-day strip, different people and content; A gives a span of days 2–4, B clarifies day 4.
